items.exampleEn: It's dangerous to swim in this river.
items.exampleZh: 在這條河裡游泳很危險。

items.exampleEn: Don't be so negative about everything!
items.exampleZh: 別對每件事都那麼負面！

items.exampleEn: Is there a direct bus to the airport?
Children feel safe in a familiar place.
items.exampleZh: 孩子在熟悉的地方會覺得安心。

items.exampleEn: Jeans are not appropriate for the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 牛仔褲不適合穿去開會。

items.exampleEn: Young children often don't see danger.
items.exampleZh: 小孩子常常察覺不到危險。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother taught me the importance of family.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶教我家人有多重要。

items.sentenceEn: This street looks familiar to me.

items.audioEn: Take the direct train. It's faster than the bus.
items.audioZh: 搭直達的火車吧，比公車快。

items.sentenceEn: We took a direct flight to Tokyo.
items.sentenceZh: 我們搭直飛班機到東京。

items.stemEn: Don't play near the busy road. It's ____.
items.stemZh: 不要在車多的路旁邊玩，很危險。

items.stemEn: Everyone should understand the ____ of drinking enough water.
items.stemZh: 每個人都應該知道喝足夠的水有多重要。

items.passageEn: Every year, a lot of plastic goes into the sea. Plastic bags and bottles are a real danger to fish and birds. Most people are familiar with this problem, but some think one person can't change anything. That is a negative way of thinking. My teacher always talks about the importance of small steps, like bringing your own bag and cup.
items.passageZh: 每年都有很多塑膠流進海裡。塑膠袋和塑膠瓶對魚和鳥來說是真正的危險。大多數人都很清楚這個問題，但有些人認為一個人改變不了什麼。這是一種負面的想法。我的老師總是談到小小行動的重要性，像是自己帶袋子和杯子。

options: 去商店多買一些新的塑膠袋和塑膠瓶
自己帶袋子和杯子之類的小行動

items.promptZh: 晚上一個人走這條路很危險。
referenceEn: It's dangerous to walk on this road alone at night.
Walking on this road alone at night is dangerous.
rubricZh: 可用 It's dangerous to＋原形動詞，也可用動名詞當主詞（例如 Walking … is dangerous）

items.instructionZh: 用 familiar 造一個句子，說說某個讓你覺得熟悉的人、地方或東西。
referenceEn: This song sounds familiar to me.
I am familiar with this part of the city.
rubricZh: familiar 表示「熟悉的」，可寫例如 look familiar、sound familiar、be familiar with＋人／地方／東西
look、sound 後面接形容詞（例如 sounds familiar）
